title: Consumer Credit Default Risk & Portfolio Monitoring

source.dataBoundary: UCI Default of Credit Card Clients, CC BY 4.0. The local release candidate publishes non-demographic research fields; demographics remain local and audit-only.

evidence.claim: The deployed dashboard is the prior full-record explorer; the fail-closed, non-demographic successor remains a local release candidate pending approval and live verification.
The calibrated challenger achieved AUROC 0.7915, PR-AUC 0.5737, Brier score 0.1315, and 10-bin calibration error 0.0120 on the fixed stratified UCI benchmark split.
